plugins.name: regai
plugins.description: Your in-house Vietnamese legal consultant in Claude Code. Answers are grounded in a curated, always-current corpus of Vietnamese law — with in-force status and related documents enforced on every answer, and every claim cited — instead of a general model's outdated, unsourced training data. Ships with workflows and templates for drafting, review, memos and compliance, and learns your industry and house style over time.

skills.name: regai-listing-coverage
skills.description: Use when the user asks what the regai knowledge base covers, whether a particular law/topic/document is in it ("do you have labor law?", "is Nghị định 13/2023 in the corpus?", "can you research tax?"), or before telling a user that a topic is out of scope. Determines coverage by probing the live corpus, never from memory — the corpus grows over time as documents are added from the remote.
headings: Checking what the regai corpus covers
To check whether a specific topic or document is covered
To answer "what does the knowledge base cover?"
skills.description_zh: 通过实时查询 regai 语料库核实越南法律知识库的覆盖范围，判断某部法律、主题或文件是否收录；适用于查询可研究内容，或在认定主题超出范围之前检查，避免依赖可能过时的记忆。

skills.name: regai-live-check
skills.description: Use when the user asks anything about Vietnamese law against the latest live data source — conditions/procedures for something ("điều kiện chào bán chứng khoán", "what do I need to issue shares?"), whether a document is still valid ("Nghị định 58/2012 còn hiệu lực không?", "is decree X still in force?"), which Nghị định/Thông tư implements a Luật, or to quote a specific Điều. Drives the regai retrieval tools and the cite-correctly research loop.
headings: Pick the right entry point first
Reading order — the Vietnamese legal hierarchy
skills.description_zh: 利用 regai 最新实时数据源研究越南法律的条件与程序、文件现行效力、法律配套法令或通知，以及具体条文；通过检索与引用校验循环形成有出处的研究结果。

skills.name: regai-onboard
skills.description: Use the first time a user works on a legal goal in a workspace, when `.regai/context.md` is missing or still empty (only the seed comment), or when the user says "set up regai for my company", "regai doesn't know my org", "onboard me", "tell regai about us", or runs /regai-onboard. Interviews the user briefly and writes their org/house-style profile so every later mission is grounded in their context instead of guessing.
skills.description_zh: 首次在工作区开展法律任务、.regai/context.md 缺失或尚为空时，简短访谈用户并建立组织背景与行文风格资料，为后续任务提供明确上下文；也适用于用户主动要求配置公司资料。

skills.name: regai-shipping-goal
skills.description: Use when the user gives a multi-step legal GOAL to carry to completion — "draft an NDA / service contract", "review this contract for risks", "review this product proposal", "write a legal memo on X", "build a compliance process". Plans the work, gets approval, then executes like a legal associate with checkpoints, grounding every legal claim in the regai corpus and compounding what it learns across sessions. For one-off questions about what the law says, use regai-live-check instead.
headings: Shipping a legal goal with regai
skills.description_zh: 推进起草保密协议或服务合同、合同风险审查、产品方案审查、法律备忘录及合规流程等多步骤目标：先规划并取得批准，再按检查点执行，以 regai 语料支持法律主张并积累会话经验；单次法律问答改用实时查询技能。

skills.name: regai-vault-search
skills.description: Use when the user asks anything about Vietnamese law and you want to search the local vault/ folder directly (offline, no MCP/Supabase), or when the user asks to continue after the live MCP tools are unavailable. Same research goals as regai-live-check but uses grep/Read over vault/ instead of the remote tools.
headings: Researching Vietnamese Law via Local Vault
Resolving "is this in force?" — the same rule the engine uses
Reading order — the Vietnamese legal hierarchy
skills.description_zh: 直接搜索本地 vault/ 中的越南法律资料，支持离线或无 MCP、Supabase 的研究，也用于实时检索工具不可用后继续工作；研究目标与实时查询技能相同，检索方式改为本地文本搜索和读取。

commands.name: regai-doctor
commands.description: Check the regai MCP connection and verify the corpus is reachable.
